# CheckYourself

> Local-first completion-evidence review for AI-built apps: verifier-owned challenges, verifier-checked receipts, bounded 0–100 scoring, stable rule IDs, and guided fixes. It does not prove production safety or provide independent external custody.

## Getting Started

- [README.md](README.md) — overview, quick start, what it checks, CLI/MCP setup, FAQ
- [START_HERE.md](START_HERE.md) — entry point for AI assistants starting a new audit session
- [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md) — project context file that orients the AI assistant to the audit workspace
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md) — agent behavioral rules, roast-lite voice, safety model, and approval gates

## Core Reference

- [rules.md](rules.md) — review, safety, evidence, and workflow rules for the diagnostic
- [docs/cli.md](docs/cli.md) — canonical detector-rule registry and CLI command reference (scan, diagnostic, diff, score, coverage, challenge, validate, backlog, next)
- [docs/mcp.md](docs/mcp.md) — MCP server setup, tool list, scan-root confinement, expected agent flow
- [CHANGELOG.md](CHANGELOG.md) — version history including the v1.7.0 diff command and stable rule IDs

## Schemas

The `schemas/` directory contains JSON schema contracts for every structured output:

- [schemas/scan.schema.json](schemas/scan.schema.json) — findings from a scan run
- [schemas/diff.schema.json](schemas/diff.schema.json) — diff output (added/resolved/regressed findings)
- [schemas/score-result.schema.json](schemas/score-result.schema.json) — scored report with severity caps
- [schemas/checkyourself-report.schema.json](schemas/checkyourself-report.schema.json) — full diagnostic report
- [schemas/coverage.schema.json](schemas/coverage.schema.json) — reviewer assertions, verifier-captured receipts, delegation evidence, and claim bindings
- [schemas/backlog.schema.json](schemas/backlog.schema.json) — ranked fix backlog
- [schemas/next-batch.schema.json](schemas/next-batch.schema.json) — next highest-severity batch; safety analysis remains with the diagnostic and reviewer

## Verified capabilities

- `challenge` executes committed `.checkyourself/challenges.json` definitions with argv-only commands and bounded timeouts. A failed or timed-out challenge fails closed.
- Verifier-executed `EXECUTED` receipts are the only full-credit evidence class. Caller-issued receipts are labeled `UNVERIFIED` and receive capped credit.
- Score-time re-execution runs a fresh verifier check and requires matching exit state, assertions, source/challenge bindings, and a semantic output digest. Volatile durations, timestamps, and paths are normalized; raw capture hashing remains tamper evidence.
- Verifier-owned per-surface minimum contracts reject or cap semantic vacuity: no-op commands, echo/print-only output, hollow test-runner output, and trivial regexes do not earn full credit.
- The local integrity HMAC detects project-local receipt tampering. It is not proof of independent issuance or operator identity; externally controlled custody is future work.
- `--claim` records the accepted completion claim and labels evidence as claim-bound or unbound.
- Report validation labels schema validity separately from semantic verdict consistency and recomputes verdicts.
- The ASTRA adversarial review found eight findings; the retrofit closed them. See [`_retrofit-2026-09-04/ASTRA-REVIEW.md`](_retrofit-2026-09-04/ASTRA-REVIEW.md) and [`_retrofit-2026-09-04/ASTRA-FIX-REPORT.md`](_retrofit-2026-09-04/ASTRA-FIX-REPORT.md).

## Current repository facts

- 20 canonical coverage surfaces across 10 scored categories.
- `python3 -m pytest tests/ -q`: 150 tests passed and 88 subtests passed.
- `python3 tools/validate_public.py .`: passed.
- Apache License 2.0 is the license of record; see [`LICENSE`](LICENSE).

## Boundaries

- Local-first means the verifier runs in the inspected project. The score is bounded evidence, not a production-safety guarantee.
- The HMAC is local tamper evidence, not independent issuance or external attestation.
- Challenge definitions test the accepted completion claim but do not replace production tests, expert review, or owner approval.
